mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have pleasant, partly cloudy skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 79 degrees and a Waxing Gibbous moon rising.

The city has launched an eighteen month effort to update our 2026 Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long term guide for housing, transportation, and economic development. Residents are encouraged to visit the Envision Verona project website to participate in the planning process.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, followed by trivia at The Bogey Factory.
For this week's update, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana after detecting the odor of the substance in the vehicle.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. It is a delicious choice, and the store is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
